monsterKnowledge.title: Monster Lore
monsterKnowledge.nextLevelProgress: Progress to the next monster knowledge level

descriptions.alchemy: Allows you to craft potions and elixirs.
descriptions.hunting: Hunting animals provides hides and material for bowstrings.
descriptions.lumberjacking: Allows harvesting different types of wood based on your skill rank and the tree rarity.
descriptions.blacksmithy: A skill for crafting metal weapons.
descriptions.armorsmithy: A skill for crafting metal armor.
descriptions.mining: Allows you to mine and smelt ores of various materials, mine coal, and recognize deposit rarity up to your skill rank while holding a pickaxe.
descriptions.swords: Allows you to equip and effectively use Swords in combat
descriptions.axes: Allows you to equip and effectively use Axes in combat
descriptions.maces: Allows you to equip and effectively use Maces in combat
descriptions.polearms: Allows you to equip and effectively use Polearms in combat
descriptions.bows: Allows you to equip and effectively use Bows in combat
descriptions.powerStrike: A fast, powerful weapon strike whose bonus attack increases by 15% per skill level
descriptions.preciseShot: A bow shot that always lands as a perfect hit and whose bonus attack increases by 7.5% per skill level
descriptions.leatherArmor: Allows you to equip and effectively use Leather Armor
descriptions.chainArmor: Allows you to equip and effectively use Chain Armor
descriptions.plateArmor: Allows you to equip and effectively use Plate Armor
descriptions.shields: Allows you to equip and effectively use Shields
descriptions.camping: Allows you to set up a camp for rest and increases regeneration while resting at a campfire by 25% per level
descriptions.healing: Allows you to heal injuries using bandages

progress.learnNovice: You do not know this skill yet

bonuses.lumberjackingCapacityPreservation: Adds a {percent}% bonus to tree yield.
bonuses.miningMaxOre: Allows mining ores up to {ore} and recognizing deposit rarity based on your skill rank.
bonuses.huntingExtraMaterial: Successful hunts have a {percent}% chance to yield one extra piece of the same material.
bonuses.blacksmithy: Allows you to craft more complex metal weapons of higher quality.
bonuses.armorsmithy: Allows you to craft more complex metal armor and shields of higher quality.
bonuses.bowcraft: Allows you to craft more complex bows of higher quality.
bonuses.blacksmithyExpert: Skilled workmanship saves {range}% of crafting materials.
bonuses.blacksmithyGrandmaster: Flawless workmanship saves {range}% of crafting materials.
